data.summary: Shivam Bajaj is a result driven professional with over 4 years in the financial services sector. Combining his academic background in Information Technology and Finance, he has excelled in roles at Fund Administrators, Investment Banks, and Big 4 firms, showcasing expertise in fund accounting and end-to-end operations for Hedge Funds and Private Equity. With a distinguished professional background, Shivam has worked at SS&C Technologies, BNP Paribas and KPMG. His commitment to excellence, coupled with a strong analytical acumen, positions him as a valuable asset for any organisation seeking top-tier financial talent.

raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Consultant, KPMG Global Services Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai
0 1 / 2 0 2 4 - 0 5 / 2 0 2 6
Promoted to Consultant in recognition of strong performance, technical expertise, and consistent contribution to fund accounting and advisory engagements.
Performed full-cycle fund accounting activities including bank reconciliations, journal entry preparation, cash break resolution, and trial balance validation.
Managed fair value accounting, waterfall calculations, and updated financial statements, and ledgers for multiple funds.
Posted journal entries and accounting adjustments while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Conducted Capital Activity checks (ITD/QTD), supported management fee calculations, and maintained audit-ready documentation using Yardi Capital Roll Forward reports.
Provided technical accounting advisory on complex transactions by interpreting US GAAP and IFRS requirements, supported by in-depth accounting research using authoritative literature and Big 4 guidance.
Leveraged AI-enabled research tools and advanced MS Office capabilities to prepare structured, reviewer-ready documentation, improving efficiency and reducing rework.
Mentored junior team members on technical accounting interpretations and disclosure requirements, ensuring consistency and quality across deliverables.
Reviewed financial statements in accordance with US GAAP and/or IFRS Investment Company Accounting

1 0 / 2 0 2 3 - 0 1 / 2 0 2 4
Cash and position reconciliation using Geneva software.
Income reconciliation (dividends and interest).
Manual pricing and pricing review.
Fees accrual, management, and performance fee calculation.
Capital bookings and reconciliation with Investor services system reports.
Completed monthly reconciliations and NAV calculations.
Delivery on audit requests and resolution of queries.
Compliance with internal organizational and business policies.
Associate, SS&C Globeop Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai
0 6 / 2 0 2 1 - 0 7 / 2 0 2 3

Certified in Geneva Core Accounting and Architecture.

Collaborated with stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.
Provided training to new team members.
